Name: Rice-ified Tropical Curry
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I looked at the tropical curry recipe and thought it was kinda weird that it didn't have any sort of "bulk" to it. Sure, rice might be IMPLIED, but why imply it, when you have it!

This mod simply adds rice to the recipe and ups the sell price by 100 to account for that.



[b][i]Note: The new sell price will only apply to newly cooked Tropical Curry[/i]

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b] [/b]
